purpose: Prospective Kimi four-condition method and complete-budget proposal; supersedes earlier n8 planning only. No experiment executed by this draft.

latest_user_scope.glm_original_40: Frozen 35 success / 5 failure; unchanged; no R24

design.method: Williams four rows each repeated twice, then two distinct rows sampled without replacement; shuffle resulting ten rows with same seeded RNG
design.rng_algorithm: random.Random(seed); sample(range(4),2); construct two copies of each row; append selected rows; shuffle
design.limits: Ten blocks cannot be completely position-balanced: each condition-position and directed within-block predecessor count is 2 or 3. No claim about cross-block carryover; services reset between blocks.

failure_rules.replacement: No failed ID replacement, no outcome-driven additional samples or retries. Same-class failure stop remains binding. Stopping may leave planned IDs unstarted.
failure_rules.denominators: Report planned, started, successful, failed and unstarted separately per condition; failures remain in started denominators. If all 40 start, denominator is ten per condition. Unstarted is not timeout.
failure_rules.complete_block: Inferential subset requires all four conditions valid and successful under identical frozen protocol/source/cache gates. Eligibility independent of measured latency. Preserve all attempts outside subset; complete-case latency claims are conditional on success and can have survivor bias.
failure_rules.censoring: Keep failure times and right-censoring separately; do not substitute timeout limits as observed completion durations.

primary_metric.name: business_startup_s
primary_metric.end: Receipt of the first correct arithmetic HTTP response
primary_metric.not: Not fixed32 startup, not client streaming TTFT, not isolated weight-load time. Backend first nonempty token observation is a separate event.

statistics.paired_direction: first minus second condition within complete block
statistics.exact_test: Enumerate all 2^n paired sign flips, two-sided abs(mean difference), tie tolerance 1e-12; retain n actual complete blocks rather than hardcode ten
statistics.multiple_testing: Four primary business comparisons Holm step-down alpha .05. Four including-preparation comparisons are a separate secondary family; no joint eight-test FWER claim.

n10_attainability.interpretation: Attainability only, not power or effect-size guarantee. Fewer complete blocks change the attainable grid.

estimates: successful mean, median and nearest-rank P90 with actual n
paired mean differences and paired mean ratios A/B (not mean of blockwise ratios)
Cohen dz only when sample SD defined
statistics.bootstrap: Paired block bootstrap B=10000, fixed seed20261106 reset per statistic; percentile floor(p*(B-1)); marginal 95% intervals, not simultaneous. Undefined ratios/SD/intervals explicitly unavailable.
statistics.assumptions: Serial shared-host pairing and randomization do not prove independent blocks or sign-invariant null errors. Report assumptions and failures.

power_sensitivity.empirical_power: Unknown: no Kimi four-condition formal observations or credible paired variance estimate. Do not borrow GLM effects/variance.
power_sensitivity.table_definition: Independent continuous Normal paired differences with shift d=Delta/sigma: q=Phi(d), probability all ten share sign=q^10+(1-q)^10. All-same-sign yields minimum raw p and can pass first Holm threshold for that comparison. This is a sufficient-event probability, NOT actual exact-test power, NOT joint power, NOT guaranteed detectable effect; rejection can also occur for other patterns.

cost_windows.preparation: Measure actual condition-specific reset/eviction/hot-read/pool-prefill and verification; pool initialization infrastructure separately identified, not silently hidden.
cost_windows.secondary_including_preparation: GLM-compatible P+B = preparation duration plus business duration, excluding preparation-complete to register gap G; report G separately.
cost_windows.additional_full_wall_view: Report P+G+B and remaining correctness requests, delete, mandatory release observation separately. Research-required 60-second waits are not production delete latency.
cost_windows.one_off_costs: Historical conversion and shared infrastructure costs reported by node/config and not amortized into a claimed break-even without an explicit workload/lifetime policy.

matched_configuration_proposal.stack: All four conditions native HTTP, same GPUs, scheduler and placement; SF explicit safetensors backend points to raw SF path while registered alias reuses existing converted model identity to avoid download. placement.memory_pool=[] prevents automatic preloading.

requests.top_p: Omitted like actual GLM runner; effective default must be source/runtime-bound before claiming alignment. Do not guess 1.
requests.template: Kimi tokenizer/template and thinking=False,preserve_thinking=False; no GLM token IDs or enable_thinking kwargs copied.
requests.correctness: Independent Kimi SF gold required; exact IDs through existing trace_debug/token actor path, not unsupported native SamplingParams return_token_ids argument.

matched_configuration_proposal.engine_seed: Engine seed0 distinct from request seed20261024.
matched_configuration_proposal.jit: Every attempt uses fresh empty unique per-run JIT directory, identical policy across conditions; actual receipts required.
matched_configuration_proposal.performance_scope: q3 /home is NFS; cold/hot mincore gates describe client page-cache residency only, not NFS-server cache or physical disk cold/hot. Never combine q0 local-XFS timings as same storage condition.
matched_configuration_proposal.cache_gates: All timed input files client-residency zero for cold or full for hot; pool-hit all eight actual model replicas completely resident/ready in SDK host pool. Fresh processes/GPU idle/prefix-cache state are not substitutes.
matched_configuration_proposal.memory_budget_pending: Full RAM arithmetic including 640GiB pool, SF/Store CPU construction, input/NFS page cache, tmpfs, pinned mappings and driver margin must close in actual prospective controller; O_DIRECT applies only where actually proven.

observed_planning_clues_not_formal_sampl.limitations: Single cache-uncontrolled old-AAB functional run. First-request figures are not register-origin nor isolated load times; neither cold/hot nor pool-hit formal labels. Different old prompts; cannot estimate formal four-condition effect/variance or expected completion interval. Existing q0 SF weights333.34s/compile118.46s used different eager/cache configuration and local storage, not matched q3 measurements.

complete_budget_proposal.classification: Hard resource upper-bound proposal, NOT predicted elapsed time or guaranteed successful completion. Cold/hot/preparation performance remains unmeasured.
complete_budget_proposal.coverage: Bootstrap/pool initialization and ordered final service shutdown, cleanup, at least60s release observation and evidence must all be allocated within four condition slots; no unbudgeted shared overhead. Actual phase sums and absolute native-unit/guard/observer deadlines must be independently reviewed before freeze.
complete_budget_proposal.existing_controller_limit: Existing native7200 short guard/model deadlines cannot simply be reused for an eight-hour continuous block. Adapt an existing profile with complete bounds, no new framework, before admission.
complete_budget_proposal.window: Current q3 reservation ending01:00 does not cover a full28800s block. No partial-block launch. Future full-window/resource/probe/guard/source and user-admission rules remain binding.
complete_budget_proposal.changes: Any smaller validated cap chosen before protocol freeze only, not after observing results or to fit a short remaining window.
